title: No Mind Checks Itself
hero_prompt: A wide hand-drawn lithograph in the manner of M.C. Escher's Drawing Hands: two hands rising from a single sheet of paper, each one drawing the other into being, fine grey-black tonal linework, nothing written on the paper. Hand-made Escher-style hand-drawn lithograph, with visible ink, brush or print texture on paper; flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no glossy highlights.
icon_prompt: A bold high-contrast emblem of a hand drawing itself in a closed loop, thick unbroken outline, no fine crosshatching, reading instantly as a simple looped mark at small size.
